data.name: Alberto
data.gender_notes: Alberto is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Albinus, meaning 'noble' or 'white'. This name was commonly given to children born with fair complexions. The name gained popularity in the Middle Ages, particularly among the nobility, and was later borne by several saints. The name Alberto carries the meaning “Noble or Bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Alberto usually hope their child will grow to embody noble or bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Alberto belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble or Bright.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alberto total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
